issue: Users receive 401 Unauthorized responses immediately after successful login after a deployment.
fix: Verify the active JWT signing secret/version on every backend node, then perform a rolling restart of nodes that still use the stale secret.

issue: Enterprise SAML SSO login fails after identity provider certificate rotation.
fix: Validate the IdP x509 certificate and update the SSO configuration before retrying authentication.

issue: Valid HTTP Bearer authentication is rejected because the authorization parser compares the normalized scheme with token instead of bearer.
fix: Inspect the supplied authentication contract and parser, align the unique scheme comparison with Bearer, then rerun the same trusted authentication test before claiming recovery.

issue: Production requests time out while writing user profiles because the Postgres connection pool is exhausted.
fix: Inspect active connections and pool saturation, recover leaked connections, and increase pool capacity only after confirming workload limits.

issue: Dashboard search queries are slow because a high-volume table performs sequential scans.
fix: Inspect the query plan and add the missing index using a non-blocking migration strategy.

issue: API routes return 502 Bad Gateway because the reverse proxy cannot reach application workers.
fix: Check worker health and port bindings, restore the upstream service, then verify the health endpoint through the proxy.

issue: A mobile layout regression causes buttons and text to overlap after a CSS change.
fix: Compare the latest style changes, restore the responsive spacing rule, and verify affected breakpoints before deployment.

issue: Kubernetes pods enter CrashLoopBackOff after a deployment because the readiness configuration no longer matches the service.
fix: Inspect pod events and health probe output, correct the readiness configuration, then confirm stable replicas before rollout completion.

issue: A service fails with no space left on device because application logs filled the disk.
fix: Confirm disk usage, rotate or remove safe stale logs, then enforce log retention and disk monitoring.
